test_policy: Hyperparameters are frozen from validation seeds 1/2/3. Test is evaluated once on fresh seeds 4/5/6.
paired_control: Within each shot and seed, Tip-Adapter-F and TOGA use the same support split, optimizer learning rate, epochs, batch size, and validation-selection protocol.

go_rule.delta_definition: TOGA final test accuracy minus Tip-Adapter-F final test accuracy, in percentage points
